title: How Sustainable Is The AI Capex Boom?
gist: Gavekal argues the AI capex boom is the single load-bearing support under global growth, equity markets and bond yields, so a rollover would reverse all three at once — hitting profits well beyond Nvidia, erasing the US wealth effect, and making investment grade bond yields look attractive. The teaser text does not actually answer the title's sustainability question; it maps the transmission channels of a rollover and urges constant monitoring for signs capex is turning.

themes.theme: AI Capex as Single Load-Bearing Macro Support

insights.claim: The AI capex boom is simultaneously supporting economic growth, equity markets and bond yields around the world, making it a single point of failure underneath today's three biggest macro trends.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Correlation risk is understated: a single variable (AI capex) drives equities, growth and rates together, so conventional stock/bond diversification would fail if it turns.
insights.quote: The AI capex boom is supporting economic growth, equity markets, and bond yields around the world.

insights.claim: A rollover in AI capex spending would weigh on corporate profits throughout the economy, not just on companies directly exposed to AI capex such as Nvidia.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Hedging AI risk by avoiding semis alone is insufficient — broad-market earnings estimates carry embedded AI capex beta.

themes.theme: Wealth Effect as the Consumption Transmission Channel

insights.claim: Falling equity prices caused by an AI capex rollover would erase much of the wealth effect currently supporting consumption, with the US most exposed.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: The chain runs capex to profits to equities to US consumer spending, so an AI drawdown would show up in consumer-discretionary demand rather than staying contained in tech.
insights.quote: erasing much of the wealth effect supporting consumption—especially in the US
insights.locator: In turn, that would weigh on equity prices

themes.theme: Corporate Borrowing as a Hidden Prop Under Bond Yields

insights.claim: Corporate borrowing to finance AI capex is a significant support for bond yields, so if companies stop borrowing that support is removed.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Watch corporate issuance tied to AI capex as a leading indicator for rates — a funding slowdown argues for lower yields, not higher.

insights.so_what: Investment grade credit is the identified beneficiary of an AI capex bust — a candidate hedge against long AI-linked equity exposure.

themes.theme: Capex Rollover as the Master Risk Indicator

insights.claim: A rollover in the AI capex boom could reverse today's biggest macroeconomic and market trends at once, so investors should treat signs of capex rolling over as a standing monitoring priority rather than a tail-risk afterthought.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Build a dashboard of AI capex indicators (orders, guidance, financing) as the trigger for a broad regime-flip trade rather than a single-sector call.
insights.quote: This means investors need constantly to be on the lookout for threats to the AI boom and signs that capex is rolling over.
